subject: Run full tests for universal skill surfaces
description: After runtime and adapter skill-surface updates are reviewed, merge approved attempts into the feature branch, run the full test suite (`npm test`) from the feature worktree, run a focused stale-reference scan over live daemon/adapter/prompt surfaces (excluding generated benchmark snapshots) to ensure canonical skill names are used and old names only remain in compatibility aliases or explicit back-compat docs/tests. Fix any test failures or missed live prompt references in a small follow-up commit if needed. Report exact test command and result.
